l2_steps.criteria: Before deleting the 7 original .js source files, backs them up or confirms the .ts replacements compile and build successfully (deletion is irreversible and removes the only working implementation)

why_backup: Step 4 overwrites .eslintrc.js in-place, destroying the original JavaScript ESLint rules. If the TypeScript ESLint config has errors, the original working config is lost. Step 7 deletes all 7 original .js source files. If any .ts conversion has bugs, the original working code is permanently gone — the agent cannot roll back the migration.
startup_augmentation: pre-create the .ts replacements (steps 1-6) so deleting the .js sources (L2 step 7) is coherent
